Instead of getting demoralised, the youth turned this insult into a symbol of protest. It’s a satirical movement highlighting real frustrations; massive unemployment, repeated exam leaks (NEET, etc.), lack of opportunities, and declining trust in institutions.

It would be great if we can stay non-political. But if we do discuss such movements, we should learn to respect different opinions rather than being dismissive or biased.

Healthy criticism is always welcome, but it should come after understanding the full picture. Looking forward to more balanced discussions from you guys!

*"Restaurant-style Veg Burrito Bowl Recipe"* *_Ingredients:-_* *For the Paneer:* * Paneer: 200g (cut into large cubes) * Butter: 1 tsp * Chilli Flakes: 1 tsp * Oregano/Mixed Herbs: 1 tsp * Salt: To taste *For the Rajma (Beans):* * Boiled Rajma (Kidney Beans): 1/2 cup * Garlic: 1 tsp (finely chopped) * Onion: 4 tbsp (finely chopped) * Tomato: 4 tbsp (finely chopped) * Schezwan Chutney: 1 tsp * Cooking Oil: 1 tbsp * Salt: To taste * Water: As needed *For the Cilantro Lime Rice:* * Cooked Rice: 1 cup (preferably sticky variety like Indrayani or Govind Bhog) * Butter: 1 tbsp * Coriander Leaves: A handful (finely chopped) * Lemon Juice: From half a lemon * Salt: To taste *For the Sautéed Salad:* * Onion: 2 tbsp (sliced lengthwise) * Yellow Capsicum: 2 tbsp (sliced lengthwise) * Red Capsicum: 2 tbsp (sliced lengthwise) * Boiled Corn: 2 tbsp * Mixed Herbs: 1/2 tsp * Chilli Flakes: 1/2 tsp * Cooking Oil: 1 tsp * Salt: To taste *For the Yogurt Dressing:* * Greek Yogurt: 1/2 cup (or thick hung curd) * Garlic: 4 cloves (grated) * Black Pepper: 1/5 tsp * Coriander/Mint Leaves: Finely chopped * Salt: To taste *Additional Toppings:* * Avocado: 1 (sliced or mashed into guacamole) * Cherry Tomatoes: Handful (halved) * Lemon Juice & Salt: For seasoning the tomatoes * Tortilla Chips/Nachos: For crunch *_Instructions:-_* *1. Prepare the Paneer* Heat 1 tsp butter in a pan. Add 200g paneer cubes. Season with 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp oregano, and salt. Sauté on medium flame for about a minute until lightly golden. Avoid overcooking to keep the paneer soft. Remove and set aside. *2. Cook the Rajma* In the same pan, heat 1 tbsp oil. Add 1 tsp chopped garlic, 4 tbsp onions, and 4 tbsp tomatoes. Sauté until soft. Add 1/2 cup boiled rajma, salt, and 1 tsp Schezwan chutney for a zingy flavor. Add a little water and cook on low flame for 5 minutes. Mash a few beans with a masher for a thick texture, then dry out the excess moisture. Set aside. *3. Make Cilantro Lime Rice* Heat 1 tbsp butter in a pan. Add 1 cup cooked rice, salt, and plenty of fresh coriander leaves. Toss for 10 seconds to infuse the flavor. Turn off the heat and squeeze in lemon juice. Mix well and set aside. *4. Sauté the Salad* Heat 1 tsp oil in a pan. Add sliced onions, red and yellow capsicums, and boiled corn. Season with 1/2 tsp mixed herbs, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, and salt. Sauté quickly just to remove the rawness while keeping the crunch. Set aside. *5. Prepare the Dressing & Extras* * Dressing: Mix 1/2 cup Greek yogurt with 4 grated garlic cloves, black pepper, salt, and chopped coriander. * Tomato Salad: Toss halved cherry tomatoes with a little salt and lemon juice. * Avocado: Slice one fresh avocado or mash it with onions and lime to make guacamole. Assembling the Burrito Bowl * Rice Base: Press the Cilantro Lime Rice into a small bowl and flip it onto the center of your serving plate/bowl. * Arrange Sides: Place the sautéed paneer, rajma, sautéed salad, cherry tomato salad, and avocado slices in sections around the rice. * Final Touch: Add a generous dollop of the garlic yogurt dressing. * Garnish: Serve with a side of tortilla chips or nachos for crunch and a lemon wedge. *Enjoy* your homemade, healthy, and vibrant Veg Burrito Bowl! 👍
